Authorization
I hereby attest that I agree and understand that:
•   This plan does NOT provide pediatric dental benefits that satisfy the essential health benefit
requirement of the Affordable Care Act.
•   The information I provided on this application regarding all persons to be insured is complete, true
and correct to the best of my knowledge. I realize that any false, or inaccurate statement or material
misrepresentation in the application may result in claim denial, a change in premium, or contract
rescission. Any person who injures, defrauds, or deceives any insurer, files a statement of claim or
an application containing any false, incomplete, or misleading information is guilty of a felony of the
third degree.
•   I am applying for a dental policy for myself (and my family). I am aware that the policy documents
govern regarding benefits under the plan regardless of representations made by my agent.
•   Certain fees may be included with my premium, and additional fees may be charged for late
payments, and these fees will be disclosed prior to being applied. My payments are first applied to
the fees owed and then to the premium.
•   Coverage will only be issued on the effective date assigned by National Health Insurance Company
and will be issued only upon receipt and approval of a completed application and receipt of payment
for the first month’s premium.
•   Any information I provide through this application process may be shared with persons necessary to
facilitate issuing this plan, including but not limited to my agent or broker.
•   I received MIB, Inc. and the Fair Credit Reporting Act and Privacy Pre-Notification, the Abbreviated
Notice of Insurance Information Practices, the Guide to Health Insurance for People with Medicare
and the Outline of Coverage for Health Insurance, if required.
I understand that this authorization is required in order to enable National Health Insurance Company to
make eligibility determinations relating to me and/or my minor children. Information obtained pursuant to
this authorization will remain confidential and will not be redisclosed unless authorized by you or by law.
Unless an earlier date is required by law, this authorization, including any photocopy thereof, expires
upon the earliest of the following events: 30 days after denial of my application or, if insured, 24 months
from the date signed.
I understand that I may revoke this authorization at any time by providing written notification via certified
mail to National Health Insurance Company at the following address: Privacy Office, National Health
Insurance Company, PO Box 2070, Milwaukee, WI 53201-2070. The revocation will not be valid if
National Health Insurance Company has taken action in reliance on this authorization. If I refuse to sign
or revoke this authorization, my application may not be processed.
